summary: Iteration 7: verified the requirements.txt dependency fix. Ran `pip install -r /app/backend/requirements.txt` (exit 0, no conflicts), `pip check` (No broken requirements), `python -c 'import server'` (OK), supervisor backend RUNNING. Re-ran the full pytest suite against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: 15/15 passed — /api/config shape correct (voicelive_configured:false, lisa, casual-sitting), legacy avatar endpoints 404, /api/voice/ws returns JSON error 'not configured' and closes cleanly, /api/orders/search and /api/items/search both report total=1000 with pagination and every filter (status/priority/paid_only/q/date/category/condition/in_stock_only/sku) behaving correctly and _id stripped.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt is clean minimal (~31 lines) — no litellm URL wheel, no google-genai, no huggingface_hub, no grpcio direct pins. Includes fastapi, uvicorn, motor, pymongo, python-dotenv, azure-identity, websockets, httpx as required.
server.py imports azure.identity lazily inside _entra_token(), so backend boots even without Azure creds — good.
WS handler correctly sends structured JSON error then closes when not configured; no crash.
seed_data_creation: 1000 orders + 1000 items already seeded by startup hook (no change).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requirements.txt is now clean and installs without conflicts. Backend fully functional. Frontend testing was skipped per request.
rca of the issue: Previous bloated requirements.txt (130 lines from `pip freeze`) has been replaced by a curated ~31-line direct-dependency list. pip install now resolves cleanly with exit 0 and `pip check` reports no broken requirements.
